description.value: Walmart Supercenter in Cranbrook serving the Kootenay region, carrying groceries alongside electronics, clothing, toys, and furniture under one roof. As a large-format supercenter, it is one of the most comprehensive resupply stops available to touring cyclists passing through Cranbrook. Store 3183 is located on Willowbrook Drive on the commercial strip west of the city centre.
